observations: Stainless steel electric kettle with a black plastic handle and base.
A single heating element is visible inside the kettle in photo 2.
The kettle has a capacity of 4.2L as stated in the seller's text.
A UK-style 3-pin power plug is attached to the power cord.
The interior of the kettle is shiny and appears clean.
The exterior shows some minor surface scratches and scuffs.

claims.evidence: No brand logo or badge is visible in any photo.
Photo 0 shows the 4.2L capacity and photo 2 shows the electric heating element.

risks.risk: The heating element may be burnt, corroded, or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the kettle boiling water or a photo of the heating element with a thermometer inside.

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be damaged or have internal faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the kettle plugged in and the indicator light turning on.

risks.risk: The kettle may leak or have a cracked base.
risks.proof: A video showing the kettle filled with water and boiling without leaks.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the kettle boiling water to confirm the heating element works.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the base or inside the kettle.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
